hold_ttl_min.source: spec §8 Bookings: a hold lasts 60 real minutes, never demo time (FLOW-05)
hold_ttl_min.note: env HOLD_TTL_MIN overrides it at deploy

timeout_s.source: 04-CONTEXT Claude's Discretion, engine worker hang rule (OPS-06)
timeout_s.note: well above the 3 s case budget, which stays the api.bench gate and is never raised; env ENGINE_TIMEOUT_S overrides it at deploy

queue_wait_s.source: 04-RESEARCH Pitfall 1: a bounded wait for the one engine slot, then 503 engine_busy

upload.source: spec §4 Caps (signals with a file); FLOW-11; 04-CONTEXT D-08

passcode.source: 06-CONTEXT D-24 (replaces 04-REVIEW WR-03's 20 per hour): wrong passcode attempts, counted per address
passcode.note: only a wrong passcode counts; the address is stored as a hash; on Cloud Run it is the rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry (the one Google's front end appends), locally the TCP peer; after 10 wrong guesses within one clock minute a block lasts until that minute ends (at most 60 s) and is never permanent; visitors behind one shared NAT or VPN exit share a counter (accepted, D-24)

ai.note: requests, not dollars (06-CONTEXT D-13): live questions, live briefs and AI signal analysis share it; cached briefs and manual counts do not spend it (04-CONTEXT D-20); resets at midnight Asia/Bangkok; env GLOBAL_AI_CAP overrides it at deploy

time_zone.source: spec §4: daily caps reset at midnight Bangkok time

retired_sandbox_hours.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01 (agy F-T5-03): a sandbox retired longer ago than this is no session's; its rows and keys go

session_key_days.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01: the ss_session cookie lives 30 days (app.COOKIE_MAX_AGE_S), so an older session-scoped key has no session left to retry it

usage_window_days.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01: a cap window (an hour or a day) older than this is never counted again

engine_cache_days.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01: an older cached result is computed again on its next use (results are deterministic)

runs_per_batch.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01: one bounded batch per reset or new session (no background work on Cloud Run), well inside the 2 s reset target

rows_per_batch.source: 04-REVIEW IN-01: the bound on each shared-table delete in one batch

max_body_bytes.source: 04-REVIEW WR-02 (agy F-T5-01): the JSON or form body is read up to this bound, before the passcode check
max_body_bytes.note: the demo path's bodies are a few hundred bytes; a larger one is 400 bad_request

lead_min.note: a count request is due this long before decide_by

max_per_version.source: spec §7; 04-CONTEXT D-20 (count requests share the limit)

conditions.source: 06.1-UI-SPEC open questions 2 and 5 (recommended defaults, pending the user)
conditions.note: the condition a dispatch or receipt records (06.1 D-48)

resolutions.source: 06.1-UI-SPEC open questions 2 and 5 (recommended defaults, pending the user)
resolutions.note: how a receipt discrepancy is reconciled (06.1 D-65)
